plan_review.notes: Alt A: core NPC proximity only — rejected because the AI still needs explicit targeted NPC-progress intent. Alt B: persist static scenario anchors — rejected because the existing reachable-anchor helper already derives deterministic live-map anchors and widening its use is smaller. Alt C: direct objectives only — rejected because detours and repeated revisits would keep split semantics. Chosen design: shared NPC-targeted progress helper + structured metadata + shared bounded actionability rule; review tightened cache/proximity invariants and detour coverage without changing the core direction.
